notes:
Topline: SMB B2B SaaS building an in‑app chat assistant for product users. Self-serve sign-up -> used free credits -> ran quick POC. Focus: streaming latency (UX must feel instant), low token cost for high volume support flows.

Firmographics:
- Founded 2020, product-led growth, core product is customer success platform for SMB SaaS.
- Team size ~80 (51-200). HQ in SF.
- CTO + Head of Product are primary technical stakeholders.

Requirements / preferences:
- Workloads: low-latency streaming chat (initial message + per-token streaming), some embeddings for short-term context retrieval (light).
- Latency targets: p50 ~100-200ms, p95 target <=350-500ms for initial response; per-token streaming must appear continuous.
- Throughput: modest (tens of concurrent users during spikes), expecting 5-10k messages/month to start.
- Cost sensitivity: high; SMB budget. Wants predictable per-message cost and clear token breakdowns.
- Models: open to small/medium open models that give best latency/cost tradeoff; curious about Redwood verified model catalog.
- Routing/fallback: want simple fallback to cheaper variants under load.
- Security: needs SSO (Okta), SOC2 is required for some buyers, audit logs for activity. Prefer public cloud deployment (hosted API).

Quote snippets from calls:
- "UI has to feel instant — if the chat stalls users drop off."
- "We want a pricing signal up front; can't have surprises after we scale."

Recent timeline (bullets):
- 2026-02-18: Self-serve signup, created trial project, ran 50 test conversations. (gt_20260218_signup_reply)
- 2026-02-20: Intro call with AE (Alyssa) + SE (Marco). Demo of streaming + chat SDK. Fireflies: ff_20260220_01. Notes: liked streaming latency, asked about prefix caching + KV reuse.
- 2026-02-22: Sent security questionnaire (small SOC2 items); customer asked for SOC2 attestation doc link. Shared /drive/pricing_deck/chatlayer_intro_pricing_v2.pdf.
- 2026-02-24: Customer ran mini stress test (server-side) using hosted API; reported p95 spikes ~700ms under burst — concerned. Created internal triage with SE to tune batching/caching. Jira (internal) created for follow-up.
- 2026-02-27: Follow-up call scheduled; agreed to run a 2-week in-app streaming trial with Redwood defaults + recommended batching/kv cache settings.

POC scope & success metrics:
- 2-week trial: instrument p50/p95 latency, streaming continuity (no >300ms gaps), token cost per conversation.
- Success = p95 < 400ms on baseline load and cost < $0.10/conversation (start).

Next steps (short):
- Provide SOC2 doc link, Okta SSO quickstart & sample SAML config, sample ingest for embeddings.
- SE (Marco) to share suggested batching/cache config + small tuning playbook.
- Start billing-trial toggle + add monitoring dashboard for p50/p95 tokens.

AE notes / internal asks:
- Push for hosted_api upsell; likely SMB self-serve -> convert if trial meets latency and cost checks.
- Watch for request to move to Dedicated if latency concerns persist.
- Prepare simple price scenario sheet for 5k / 20k msgs/month to address pricing_predictability blocker.
